first_two_chunks.text: FICTIONAL HR POLICY - RETRIEVAL TEST FIXTURE Annual leave Employees receive 20 working days of annual leave each calendar year. Requests for a planned vacation must be submitted in the HR portal at least ten working days before departure. The reporting manager approves leave based on team coverage. Up to five unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the next year and must be used by March 31. Remaining unused days expire. Annual leave is separate from casual leave and sick leave. Public holidays inside a vacation are not deducted from the annual leave balance.
